Senses.Note: This is a verdict formula, not proof that a beating occurred. Later comments can appraise the cited encounter differently; the headword itself records only that the blows are awarded or deserved.

Occurrences.Kwic: 諸人未跨法堂門，脚跟下好與三十棒。雖然如是，山僧今日也是為眾竭力。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X82/X82n1571.xml). Complete Five Lamps (Vols. 34–120). Qixian Zhiqian says that before his listeners cross the teaching-hall door their heels deserve thirty blows, then says he is still exerting himself for them.

DraftActorProof.ExactHeadwordClause: 諸人未跨法堂門，脚跟下好與三十棒。
DraftActorProof.SpeechFrame: The sentence lies in Qixian Zhiqian's named uninterrupted 上堂 address and uses 山僧 in the following sentence.
DraftActorProof.FullCaseDecision: Qixian Zhiqian is the exact utterer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 靈山會上，世尊拈華，迦葉微笑。正當恁麼時，好與三十棒。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X82/X82n1571.xml). Complete Five Lamps (Vols. 34–120). Yuelin Zhen states the flower-and-smile scene and says that precisely then thirty blows were deserved.

DraftActorProof.ExactHeadwordClause: 正當恁麼時，好與三十棒。
DraftActorProof.SpeechFrame: The line belongs to Yuelin Zhen's named continuous hall address.
DraftActorProof.FullCaseDecision: Yuelin Zhen is the exact utterer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雪竇云：兩箇老賊喫飯也不了，好與三十棒。棒雖行，且阿那箇是正賊？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X79/X79n1557.xml). Essential Compendium of the United Lamp. Xuedou Chongxian comments that the two old thieves could not even finish eating and deserve thirty blows, then asks which is the real thief.

DraftActorProof.ExactHeadwordClause: 雪竇云：兩箇老賊喫飯也不了，好與三十棒。
DraftActorProof.SpeechFrame: 雪竇云 explicitly names Xuedou Chongxian as the commentator inside Puhua's section.
DraftActorProof.FullCaseDecision: Xuedou, not the section subject, is the exact utterer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雪竇云：可惜放過，好與三十棒。這棒一棒也不較，直是罕遇作家。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X79/X79n1557.xml). Essential Compendium of the United Lamp. Xuedou Chongxian says it was regrettable to let the monk go and that he deserved thirty blows, then calls the encounter rare accomplished work.

DraftActorProof.ExactHeadwordClause: 雪竇云：可惜放過，好與三十棒。
DraftActorProof.SpeechFrame: 雪竇云 explicitly names Xuedou as the later commentator in Sansheng Huiran's section.
DraftActorProof.FullCaseDecision: Xuedou Chongxian is the exact utterer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰。汝是甚麼處人。曰。新羅人。師曰。未跨船舷。好與三十棒。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X80/X80n1565.xml). Five Lamps Compendium. Deshan Xuanjian asks where the monk is from and says that before crossing the ship's rail he already deserved thirty blows.

DraftActorProof.ExactHeadwordClause: 師曰。未跨船舷。好與三十棒。
DraftActorProof.SpeechFrame: The alternating 師曰 and monk's 曰 place the final verdict in Deshan's turn.
DraftActorProof.FullCaseDecision: Deshan Xuanjian is the exact utterer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 侍雪峰次。有二僧從階下過。峰曰。此二人堪為種草。師曰。某甲不與麼。峰曰。汝作麼生。師曰。便好與三十棒。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X80/X80n1565.xml). Five Lamps Compendium. When Xuefeng Yicun asks how he would put it, Xuansha Shibei answers that the two monks deserve thirty blows.

DraftActorProof.SpeechFrame: Within Xuansha's named section, 峰曰 names Xuefeng's question and 師曰 returns the answer to Xuansha.
DraftActorProof.FullCaseDecision: Xuansha Shibei is the exact utterer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云。這箇阿師好與三十棒。且道。過在甚處。不合偷。常住物入衣鉢下。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1998A.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dahui Pujue. Dahui Zonggao says that this teacher deserves thirty blows and then names the offense as stealing communal property into his robe and bowl.

DraftActorProof.ExactHeadwordClause: 師云。這箇阿師好與三十棒。
DraftActorProof.SpeechFrame: 師云 introduces Dahui's comment after he raises Yongjia's verse.
DraftActorProof.FullCaseDecision: Dahui Zonggao is the exact utterer.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Deserves thirty blows is a portable Chan verdict: masters assign the sentence to people, answers, and inherited cases even when no beating follows.
EvidenceBody: Qixian Zhiqian places the verdict under his listeners' heels before they cross the teaching-hall door, while Deshan Xuanjian says the unnamed visitor from Silla deserved it before crossing the ship's rail. Xuansha Shibei gives the same sentence as his answer to Xuefeng Yicun.

Yuelin Zhen applies it to the flower-and-smile case, and Xuedou Chongxian uses it in later comments while continuing to ask who the real thief is or praising rare accomplished work. Dahui Zonggao follows the verdict by naming the alleged offense, showing that the phrase announces judgment but does not end examination of the case.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: A counted beating becomes a conventional spoken verdict that can cap or reopen a public case without recording an actual strike.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: Later comments can appraise the cited encounter differently; the headword itself records only that the blows are awarded or deserved.

the same sentence applied to monks, masters, and cases
